project_type: C++20 automated crypto trading platform with CMake build system
build_system: CMake 4.4.2 with FetchContent for external dependencies. Build directory is build/. Uses Unix Makefiles generator.
test_framework: GoogleTest (optional, BUILD_TESTS=OFF by default). No tests currently built.
test_command: No tests currently configured for the TUI. Build success is the primary verification.
verification_instructions: 1. Run cmake and make in build/ directory. 2. Verify kraken_trader binary is produced. 3. Verify FTXUI is fetched and linked correctly.
environment_constraints: GCC 11.5 available (sandbox). Network available for FetchContent (GitHub). Boost 1.75, Lua 5.4.4, OpenSSL 3.5.7, libcurl 8.17.0 all available. No Docker needed.
key_patterns: Namespace: trader::. Headers in include/ mirroring src/ structure. Shared pointers for major components (rest_client, ws_client, rate_limiter, risk_manager). ScriptManager holds all script state. Main loop polls ws_client and ticks scripts at configurable interval. AppConfig loaded from TOML. spdlog for logging.
directory_structure: src/ - implementation files (core/, kraken/, scripting/, safety/). include/ - headers with same structure. config/ - trader.toml. scripts/ - Lua trading scripts. examples/ - more Lua scripts. build/ - CMake build output. third_party/ - empty (all deps via FetchContent).
